title: Raster Technology
description: Introduce a new top-level raster technology for non-destructive, multi-windowed image editing on an infinite canvas. Built on infinite_cavas Rust/WASM/Vello. Layers, masks, blend modes, adjustment layers, painting, filters. Integrated with shared hover/selection, side-panel-tree, ribbon-tool-tree, multi-window shell. Sophisticated playground.
summary:
Introduced the raster technology stack for non-destructive, multi-windowed image editing on the infinite canvas.

**Core (`raster/core`)**: `raster.document/v1` schema with pixel/group/adjustment layers, blend modes, masks, transforms, edit ops, and bidirectional/transitive hover tree-id mapping.

**Rust WASM (`raster/rs`)**: `RasterHost` compositor on `infinite_cavas` using Vello `push_layer` blend/opacity, paint buffers, mask clips, `RasterSession` with attach/render/camera/paint/sync/upload APIs.

**React (`raster/react`)**: `RasterRenderer`, `RasterCanvas`, `RasterLayerView`, `RasterMaskView` with controlled hover/selection/camera and marquee selection helpers.

**Play (`raster/play`)**: `PlaygroundRaster` with composite+navigator windows, ribbon tool tree (selection/paint/transform/adjust/filter), Layers/Masks/Properties side panels, fixture catalog, hover plumbing via `CallbackTreePanelDefinition`.

**Framework wiring**: `RasterKindHover`, `UiRasterHostSurfaceNode`, `buildRasterWindowBody`, `registerUiRasterSurfaceHost`, `bootRasterPlay` host region.

**Fixtures**: default, photo-edit, paint.

**Monorepo**: ports 6060/6061, workspaces, launch config, vite play-entry kind `raster`.

**Validation**: raster-core (4 tests), raster-react (1 test), raster-play (2 tests) pass; WASM builds; dev server on :6060; production build succeeds.
